prose: In our continuing quest to analyze the occult and mythological significance of symbolism in the Moon Knight series, we press onward to explore episode 4, "The Tomb." Major themes include the death and resurrection of the Sun-King, the dismemberment of Osiris, exposing the poor portrayal of ancient Egyptian ideas, and the ever-present broken mirror MK Ultra schizoid soul-division.
The Marvelous Demystifiers are: Chance Garton, Gabriel (Slick Dissident), Gordan Hamil.
music: Intro music, "The Balance" by Wisdom Traders
